part.text: Fixed. In `foreignIdFor` (src/Illuminate/Database/Schema/Blueprint.php:1058), the condition no longer requires `$incrementing`, so a model with a non-auto-incrementing `int` key gets a `bigint unsigned` column instead of `char(36)`. Models using UUID/ULID (`$keyIsUniqueString`) still correctly get string columns. All 33 tests in `DatabaseSchemaBlueprintTest` pass, including the non-incremented-int relationship case.
